name: verification_photo_request
description: Sent to the contractor when a job enters VERIFICATION state. Requests photographic evidence that the work has been completed satisfactorily.

components.text:
Hi {{1}},

Job {{2}} ({{3}}) has been marked as complete.

Please send a photo showing the completed work so we can verify the repair. You can also include a short comment describing what was done.

Simply reply to this message with your photo.
